property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether to fallback at a strictly later timestamp, when the block number is a multiple of 15 the reference contract will forward its entire balance to the caller (leaving address(c).balance == 0) while the mutant that removed the conditional transfer will not, so asserting address(c).balance == 0 after such a call distinguishes them.
change_summary: Remove the conditional transfer so fallback never forwards the contract balance to sender.
